definitions.gloss: to turn back, to go back
definitions.explanation: To return the way one came; to go back to the starting point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I turned back because I took the wrong road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づいて→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I turned back when I realized I forgot something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧なった⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: We turned back from the summit because the weather got bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だと⟦{感|かん}じて→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I went partway but felt it was dangerous and turned back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけ⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づいて→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I realized I forgot to lock up, so I turned back from the station to my house.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す means to turn back or return the way one came.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return). The {引|ひ}き emphasizes the physical action of turning around.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No transitive pair

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back after taking the wrong road
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to go back to get something forgotten
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back partway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return (general, to a place)
- {引|ひ}き{返|かえ}す: to turn back (emphasizes reversing direction)
